cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A clean win. Keep the board as it is; you should be proud.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You took your queen off when I put away a spare pawn. Why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Standard opening. Your rook still had to find its way to my king.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let's play again with your queen on. I want to know I can beat your whole side.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Same winning method, more pieces to get past. Show me that rook again.

reason: Replace the unsupported confidence overlay with a concrete misunderstood copied action that directs the same-holder Drive pursuit, with a responsive partner and an ending using B4.
